title: Do Green, Purple, and Black Olives Make Different Olive Oils?
excerpt: A clear explanation of how olive ripening shapes color, flavour, polyphenols, freshness, and yield. How and why early-harvest oils differ from late-harvest ones.
seoTitle: Do Green, Purple, and Black Olives Make Different Olive Oils?
seoDescription: Olive color tracks ripeness — and ripeness determines polyphenol content, flavour, and shelf life. What the chemistry of the olive means for the oil in your bottle.
